findings.current: I grinned as arrogantly as I could and kicked Jin Mukyung in the shin.
findings.defect: The draft assigns the triumphant grin to Taekyung, but Jin Mukyung is the one grinning while Taekyung kicks him.
findings.rationale: The participial phrase 의기양양하게 웃고 있는 directly modifies 진무경, while 있는 힘껏 describes the force of Taekyung’s kick.
findings.replacement: With all my strength, I kicked Jin Mukyung in the shin as he grinned triumphantly.
findings.source: 있는 힘껏 의기양양하게 웃고 있는 진무경의 정강이를 발로 깠다.

findings.current: I turned and swung my spear at the same time, but I was already too late. Jin Mukyung’s raised mouth was right in front of me.
findings.defect: “Raised mouth” is an unnatural and anatomically inaccurate rendering of his slightly upturned mouth corner.
findings.rationale: 입꼬리 specifically means the corner of the mouth, and 슬쩍 indicates that it is raised only slightly.
findings.replacement: I turned and swung my spear at the same time, but I was already too late. The faintly upturned corner of Jin Mukyung’s mouth was right in front of me.
findings.source: 그러나 이미 늦었다. 슬쩍 올라간 진무경의 입꼬리가 눈앞에 있었다.

findings.current: I might regret this later, but that was a problem for later.
findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s fear of future retaliation or consequences into personal regret.
findings.rationale: 후환 refers to trouble or repercussions that will follow, which here means Jin Mukyung’s likely retaliation.
findings.replacement: I was afraid of what he’d do to me later, but that was a problem for later.

findings.current: I felt hot blood trickling down my throat.
findings.defect: “Down my throat” suggests blood flowing internally, whereas the blood from the apparent cut is running externally down his neck.
findings.rationale: 목을 타고 흘러내리다 describes the blood running along the outside of his neck in this physical context.
findings.replacement: I felt hot blood trickling down my neck.
findings.source: 뜨거운 선혈이 목을 타고 흘러내리는 게 느껴졌다.

findings.current: My clear five senses proved that I was alive.
findings.defect: “Clear five senses” is an unnatural English collocation.
findings.rationale: 또렷한 describes his senses as vivid and fully functioning, confirming that he remains alive.
findings.replacement: All five of my senses were sharp and clear, proof that I was alive.
findings.source: 또렷한 오감이 내가 살아 있다는 사실을 증명한다.

summary: One critical subject reversal changes who is grinning; several localized issues alter a pragmatic cue, anatomical location, or natural phrasing.
